item.text: {"items":[{"source_id":"MLP-724","positive_en":"What should someone do before taking an unproven or little-known health product if they are taking prescription medicines?","positive_zh":"如果正在服用处方药，在使用未经证实或不太了解的健康产品之前应该怎么做？","evidence":"Before taking an unproven or little-known product, talk to your health care provider, especially if you are taking any prescription medicines.","expected_answer":"Talk to your health care provider first, especially if you take prescription medicines.","missing_en":"What percentage of health fraud products are contaminated or contain undisclosed harmful ingredients?","missing_reason":"The summary warns that scam products may be contaminated or contain harmful unlisted ingredients, but it does not give any percentage or rate."},{"source_id":"MLP-1246","positive_en":"Why are herbal medicines labeled natural not necessarily safe, especially when someone also takes prescription or over-the-counter medicines?","positive_zh":"为什么标着天然的草药并不一定安全，特别是同时服用处方药或非处方药时？","evidence":"Many people believe that products labeled \"natural\" are always safe and good for them. This is not necessarily true. Herbal medicines do not have to go through the testing that drugs do. Some herbs, such as comfrey and ephedra, can cause serious harm. Some herbs can interact with prescription or over-the-counter medicines.","expected_answer":"Natural-labeled herbal medicines are not necessarily safe because they do not have to undergo drug testing, some can cause serious harm, and some can interact with prescription or over-the-counter medicines.","missing_en":"What percentage of people using herbal medicines experience interactions with prescription or over-the-counter medicines?","missing_reason":"The summary states that some herbs can interact with medicines, but it does not provide a frequency, percentage, or risk estimate."},{"source_id":"MLP-5628","positive_en":"What symptoms are mentioned for allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis, also called ABPA?","positive_zh":"过敏性支气管肺曲霉病 ABPA 提到的症状有哪些？","evidence":"One kind is allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis (also called ABPA). Symptoms of ABPA include wheezing and coughing. ABPA can affect healthy people but it is most common in people with asthma or cystic fibrosis.","expected_answer":"ABPA symptoms include wheezing and coughing.","missing_en":"What percentage of people with asthma develop allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis (ABPA)?","missing_reason":"The summary says ABPA is most common in people with asthma or cystic fibrosis, but it does not state a prevalence percentage or subgroup rate."},{"source_id":"MLP-360","positive_en":"What physical symptoms may people with phobias experience if they cannot avoid what they are afraid of?","positive_zh":"有恐惧症的人如果无法避开害怕的事物，可能会出现哪些身体症状？","evidence":"People with phobias try to avoid what they are afraid of. If they cannot, they may experience: Panic and fear Rapid heartbeat Shortness of breath Trembling A strong desire to get away","expected_answer":"They may experience panic and fear, rapid heartbeat, shortness of breath, trembling, and a strong desire to get away.","missing_en":"What exact percentage of people with phobias improve with medicines compared with therapy?","missing_reason":"The summary says treatment helps most people and lists medicines, therapy, or both, but it does not provide recovery percentages or compare treatments quantitatively."},{"source_id":"MLP-1598","positive_en":"For preventing heart disease, how much sleep per night should an adult try to get?","positive_zh":"为了预防心脏病，成年人每晚应尽量睡多少小时？","evidence":"Getting enough sleep. If you don't get enough sleep, you raise your risk of high blood pressure, obesity, and diabetes. Those three things can raise your risk of heart disease. To improve your sleep: If you are an adult, try to get 7 to 9 hours of sleep per night.","expected_answer":"Adults should try to get 7 to 9 hours of sleep per night.","missing_en":"What exact percentage reduction in heart disease risk is achieved by following the DASH diet?","missing_reason":"The summary says the DASH diet can help lower blood pressure and cholesterol, which can lower heart disease risk, but it does not give a precise risk-reduction percentage."},{"source_id":"MLP-400","positive_en":"How can HPV and herpes STIs spread besides vaginal, oral, or anal sex?","positive_zh":"HPV 和疱疹这类 STI 除了阴道、口腔或肛交外，还可能怎样传播？","evidence":"STIs are usually spread during vaginal, oral, or anal sex. But sometimes they can spread through other sexual contact involving the penis, vagina, mouth, or anus. This is because some STIs, like herpes and HPV, are spread by skin-to-skin contact.","expected_answer":"Some STIs such as herpes and HPV can spread through skin-to-skin sexual contact involving the penis, vagina, mouth, or anus.","missing_en":"What exact percentage does correct latex condom use reduce the risk of catching or spreading HPV?","missing_reason":"The summary says correct latex condom use greatly reduces but does not eliminate STI risk, and mentions HPV, but it does not provide an exact HPV risk-reduction percentage."},{"source_id":"MLP-3892","positive_en":"What medicine information should be included in a personal health record?","positive_zh":"个人健康记录中应包括哪些药物信息？","evidence":"What kind of information would you put in a personal health record? You could start with: Your name, birth date, blood type, and emergency contact information Date of last physical Dates and results of tests and screenings Major illnesses and surgeries, with dates A list of your medicines and supplements, the dosages, and how long you've taken them","expected_answer":"Include a list of your medicines and supplements, their dosages, and how long you have taken them.","missing_en":"How many minutes does keeping a personal health record reduce emergency care delays?","missing_reason":"The summary lists information to include in a personal health record, but it does not quantify any reduction in emergency care delays."},{"source_id":"MLP-444","positive_en":"When should someone see a doctor before traveling out of the country for vaccines or medicines to prevent specific illnesses?","positive_zh":"出国旅行前，如果可能需要疫苗或预防特定疾病的药物，应在什么时候看医生？","evidence":"If you are traveling out of the country, you might also need vaccinations or medicines to prevent specific illnesses. Which ones you need will depend on what part of the world you're visiting, the time of year, your age, overall health status, and previous vaccinations. See your doctor 4 to 6 weeks before your trip. Most vaccines take time to become effective.","expected_answer":"See your doctor 4 to 6 weeks before your trip.","missing_en":"What percentage of travelers develop diarrhea after drinking unsafe water in developing countries?","missing_reason":"The summary says water in developing countries can contain organisms that cause stomach upset and diarrhea, but it does not provide any percentage of travelers affected."},{"source_id":"MLP-4919","positive_en":"What condition might a woman have after birth if she is extremely sad or unable to care for herself or her baby?","positive_zh":"产后如果女性极度悲伤，或无法照顾自己或宝宝，可能是什么情况？","evidence":"In addition to physical changes, you may feel sad or have the \"baby blues.\" If you are extremely sad or are unable to care for yourself or your baby, you might have a serious condition called postpartum depression .","expected_answer":"She might have postpartum depression.","missing_en":"What percentage of women with postpartum depression recover within six weeks without treatment?","missing_reason":"The summary identifies postpartum depression as a serious condition when sadness is extreme or caregiving is impaired, but it does not state any recovery percentage."},{"source_id":"MLP-5350","positive_en":"How often do small amounts of urine normally flow from the ureters into the bladder?","positive_zh":"正常情况下，少量尿液多久会从输尿管流入膀胱一次？","evidence":"The ureters are about 8 to 10 inches long. Muscles in the ureter walls tighten and relax to force urine down and away from the kidneys. Small amounts of urine flow from the ureters into the bladder about every 10 to 15 seconds.","expected_answer":"Small amounts of urine flow from the ureters into the bladder about every 10 to 15 seconds.","missing_en":"What percentage of ureteral blockages require surgery rather than medicines?","missing_reason":"The summary says treatment depends on the cause and may include medicines or, in severe cases, surgery, but it does not provide a percentage requiring surgery."}]}
